common_name: Lollypop Lily (White-Based Asiatic Lily with Hot Pink Tips)

planting.note: Plant bulbs 6-8 inches deep in fertile, well-drained soil in full sun to light shade; Lollypop is an Asiatic lily hybrid known for its sharply two-toned bicolor flowers.

directions: Plant bulbs 6-8 inches deep in fertile, well-drained soil in full sun to light shade, keeping the base of the plant shaded with mulch or companion plants. Lollypop bears upward-facing flowers that are pure white at the petal base and shift abruptly to vivid hot pink toward the tips, a sharp two-tone effect that gives the flower its confectionery namesake and makes it stand out clearly in a mixed bulb border. Like other Asiatic lilies it is unscented but reliably hardy and easy, blooming earlier in the season than Oriental lily cultivars. Leave the foliage in place after bloom until it yellows naturally, since it recharges the bulb for next year's flowers, and stake tall stems in windy locations if needed.

common_name: Silk Road Lily (Giant White Orienpet Lily with Burgundy Brushmarks)

planting.note: Plant bulbs 6-8 inches deep in fertile, well-drained, slightly acidic soil in full sun to light shade; Silk Road is one of the most famous Orienpet (Oriental-trumpet) hybrid lilies grown.

directions: Plant bulbs 6-8 inches deep in fertile, well-drained, slightly acidic soil in full sun to light shade, keeping the base of the plant shaded with mulch or companion plants. Silk Road bears enormous, heavily fragrant flowers with a white ground brushed and streaked in deep burgundy-pink through the center of each petal and edged in a clean white picotee band, one of the most recognizable and widely grown Orienpet lily cultivars for its combination of trumpet-lily vigor and Oriental-lily flower size. Its imposing height and outsized blooms make it a dramatic back-of-border specimen and an excellent, long-lasting cut flower. Leave the foliage in place after bloom until it yellows naturally, since it recharges the bulb for next year's flowers, and stake tall stems in windy locations.

common_name: Sorbonne Oriental Lily (Classic Fragrant Pink Cut-Flower Lily)

planting.note: Plant bulbs 6-8 inches deep in fertile, well-drained, slightly acidic soil in full sun to light shade; Sorbonne is one of the most widely grown pink Oriental lily cultivars in the commercial cut-flower trade.

directions: Plant bulbs 6-8 inches deep in fertile, well-drained, slightly acidic soil in full sun to light shade, keeping the base of the plant shaded with mulch or companion plants. Sorbonne bears large, intensely fragrant, rose-pink flowers with a lighter pink center and fine darker speckling, a dependable and widely produced Oriental lily cultivar valued in both gardens and the commercial cut-flower trade for its clear color and strong stems. Its heavy, sweet fragrance carries well through a garden bed or a cut arrangement indoors. Leave the foliage in place after bloom until it yellows naturally, since it recharges the bulb for next year's flowers, and stake tall stems in windy locations if needed.

common_name: Lady Alice Lily (Nodding Turk's-Cap-Form White Lily with Burgundy Reverse)

planting.note: Plant bulbs 6-8 inches deep in fertile, well-drained, slightly acidic soil in full sun to light shade; a distinctive nodding, recurved-petal Oriental lily cultivar.

directions: Plant bulbs 6-8 inches deep in fertile, well-drained, slightly acidic soil in full sun to light shade, keeping the base of the plant shaded with mulch or companion plants. Lady Alice bears nodding flowers with strongly recurved, swept-back white petals edged and backed in deep burgundy-red on the reverse, a Turk's-cap-like form that sets it apart from the outward- or upward-facing flowers of most Oriental lily cultivars. Its distinctive shape and fragrance make it a conversation piece in a mixed bulb border as well as an interesting addition to a cut arrangement. Leave the foliage in place after bloom until it yellows naturally, since it recharges the bulb for next year's flowers, and stake tall stems in windy locations if needed.
